verdict.rationale: Riveter is an API platform, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question. The evidence only says the local MCP server and SDKs use 'an API key'. Nothing documents issuing keys with restricted scopes or least-privilege permissions. The per-request max_credits ceiling is a spending control, not credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
